question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus reflects Xi Jinping's entrenched position as General Secretary of the Communist Party, Chairman of the Central Military Commission, and head of state, with power consolidated after the 2018 constitutional changes eliminating term limits. Recent Politburo sessions, military leadership appointments, and policy directives through mid-2026 show no public signals of succession planning or internal opposition ahead of the next party congress. Chinese elite politics historically prioritizes continuity between congresses, and no major diplomatic, economic, or security events have disrupted this pattern. Low-probability shifts could still arise from sudden health developments, elite factional moves, or external crises forcing leadership adjustments before 2027.
